english.title: Fail comply with requirement / restriction / prohibition sign on / near a private road / path near a railway / tramway
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 55 of the Transport and Works Act 1992.
english.pointstoprove:
date and Location
failing to comply with a requirement / restriction / prohibition
conveyed by a crossing sign lawfully placed on / near
a private road / path near a place where it crosses a railway / tramway

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 55(2) of the Transport and Works Act 1992 provides that In any proceedings for an offence under this section, a crossing sign on or near a private road or path near a place where it crosses a railway or tramway shall be taken to have been lawfully placed there unless the contrary is proved.
